run_GTestBreakOnFailureUnitTest: run the GTestBreakOnFailureUnitTest class to test break-on-failure mode for Google Test assertion failures
test_default_behavior: test the default behavior of Google Test when no break-on-failure flag or env var is set
test_env_var_break_on_failure: test using the GTEST_BREAK_ON_FAILURE environment variable to enable or disable seg-fault on failure
test_flag_break_on_failure: test using the --gtest_break_on_failure command line flag to control seg-fault behavior on assertion failure
test_flag_overrides_env_var: test that the --gtest_break_on_failure flag overrides the GTEST_BREAK_ON_FAILURE environment variable value
